title: 认知范畴变换器：用于语言建模的范畴论归纳偏置
summary: 提出认知范畴变换器（CCT），在GPT-2 Small骨干上集成范畴论和认知科学组件。在WikiText-103上，CCT达到21.27验证困惑度，比微调基线降低2.92 PPL（12%相对改进）。消融实验证实单纯复形消息传递贡献了84%的架构改进。
summary_en: Proposes the Cognitive Categorical Transformer (CCT), augmenting GPT-2 Small with category-theoretic and cognitive components. Achieves 21.27 validation perplexity on WikiText-103, a 2.92 PPL (12% relative) reduction over fine-tuned baseline. Ablation validates simplicial message passing contributes 84% of the improvement.
